newsitem.title: INDIA: Gujarat cotton leads Indian prices up.
newsitem.headline: Gujarat cotton leads Indian prices up.

text.p: Cotton prices rose on Tuesday amid strong demand for Gujarat varieties, dealers said.
"Gujarat cotton attracted mill buying on fears of delay in the commencement of new crop arrivals," on dealer said.
In spot deals Gujarat Kalyan rose 400-500 rupees to 13,600/13,800 per candy (355.56 kg) while Wagad cotton firmed 100 to 11,500/11,600 per candy.
"Punjab cotton rose in sympathy with Gujarat cotton," one broker said.
Punjab saw-ginned gained 40-50 rupees to 1,700/1,750 per maund (37.32 kg) while Bengal-deshi was up at 860/900 against 860/900 previous close.
